orchestrator.role: You are the executor for the Rain audit and hardening program. Execute the tasks below in order. Do not redesign the plan. Do not ask questions unless a task says STOP. Every task has exact steps, a verify block and a commit block: do them literally. Be terse in chat. Put details in files.

facts.shell: PowerShell 5.1. No bash. Chain with ';'. Never use '&&'.
facts.packages: apps/rain (app), packages/peer_core, packages/protocol_brain, packages/rain_core. Dependency graph: rain -> {peer_core, protocol_brain, rain_core}; rain_core -> protocol_brain; protocol_brain -> peer_core.
facts.baseline: HEAD (dev 601647c): analyze clean, format clean, tests: peer_core 76, protocol_brain 276, rain_core 61, apps/rain 744 pass + 20 skip. Working tree: packages/protocol_brain/lib/adapters/firebase_adapter.dart has an UNCOMMITTED edit that does not compile (missing braces at ~line 1510; 186 analyzer issues) and regresses registration rollback.
facts.git: main and dev diverged: merge-base 4798605; main +25 commits, dev +17; 51 files changed on both sides.
facts.constraints: Firebase Spark (free) tier only. Never propose Blaze-only features. Scheduled Cloud Functions in backend/firebase/functions/index.js (cleanupPresence, cleanupRooms, cleanupVoiceCalls) need Blaze. App default backend mode is rtdbOnly (packages/protocol_brain/lib/src/connection_request_backend_mode.dart).
facts.project_rules: AGENTS.md at repo root is binding. Its vault rules are handled in Phase 6.

hard_rules.rule: Work only on branch audit/rain-hardening (created in T0.1). Never commit to main or dev. Never force-push. Never rewrite history. Never run git reset --hard, git clean, git stash.
Phases 1-2 are read-only for source code: only files under audit/ may be created or changed.
Every finding cites path:line or command output. If not observed, write "INFERRED".
Never print, copy or commit secret values (keys, passwords, tokens, TURN credentials). Refer to them by key name only.
Never install global tools. Never add runtime dependencies unless the task names the exact package.
Do not run platform builds (flutter build ...). Do not deploy anything to Firebase.
Do not edit generated files (*.g.dart, *.freezed.dart) by hand. Regenerate with build_runner only when a task says so.

If a verify step fails: fix and re-run up to 3 times. Still failing: revert only your own changes for that task (git checkout -- the files you edited in this task), record it in audit/STATE.md under "Blocked", and continue with the next task.
STOP means: write the reason in audit/STATE.md, commit, push, then end the session with a 3-line summary.

tools.cmd: foreach($p in 'apps/rain','packages/peer_core','packages/protocol_brain','packages/rain_core'){ Push-Location $p; flutter analyze --no-pub; "EXIT $p $LASTEXITCODE"; Pop-Location }
foreach($p in 'packages/peer_core','packages/protocol_brain','packages/rain_core','apps/rain'){ Push-Location $p; flutter test --no-pub -r failures-only; "EXIT $p $LASTEXITCODE"; Pop-Location }
Push-Location backend/firebase/functions; npm test; "EXIT functions $LASTEXITCODE"; Pop-Location
Push-Location backend/firebase; npx --yes firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only database "node rules-test/run.js"; "EXIT rules $LASTEXITCODE"; Pop-Location
tools.note: TEST_ALL takes about 3 minutes. Run it in the background when allowed and do other read-only work meanwhile. Use -r failures-only to save tokens.
Read files with Grep (pattern + -n + small -C) or Read with offset/limit. Never read a file over 400 lines in full; read the region you need.

commit_protocol.step: git add only the files this task changed (list them explicitly; never "git add -A" or ".").
Message format: "<type>(<scope>): <summary>" then a blank line, then "Task: <task id>" and, for fixes, "Finding: <finding ids>". Types: feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, chore, ci, perf.
Use a here-string: git commit -F - with content piped, or git commit -m "<subject>" -m "<body>".
Never use --no-verify. If a hook fails, fix the cause.
Push after every phase (not every task): git push -u origin audit/rain-hardening. On network failure retry 4 times waiting 2, 4, 8, 16 seconds.
After committing, append one line to audit/STATE.md "Done" list: "<task id> <short sha> <one-line result>" and include STATE.md in the NEXT commit (do not amend).

resume_protocol.step: At session start run ENV, then: git status --short --branch; Get-Content audit/STATE.md.
If on another branch and audit/rain-hardening exists: git switch audit/rain-hardening.
Continue from the first task not listed under "Done" or "Blocked" in audit/STATE.md.
Do not re-run finished tasks. Do not re-read files already summarized in audit/*.md.

phase.name: Execute the fix plan
phase.loop: For each task card in audit/03-plan.md Phase 4, in order: 1. Skip if listed in STATE.md Done/Blocked. 2. Check "Depends on" are Done; if a dependency is Blocked, mark this card Blocked too. 3. Write the test from "Tests" first. Run it. It must fail (or, for refactors, pass as characterization). 4. Make the edits from "Steps". Keep diffs minimal. Follow the style of the surrounding file. 5. FORMAT_FIX on touched files, then the card's Verify, then ANALYZE for the touched package. 6. Commit with the card's subject and body "Task: {id}\nFinding: {ids}". 7. Every 5 cards: TEST_ALL, push the branch.

Never change the signaling wire format without keeping decode support for the old format (v=1) in the same commit. Refactor cards: move code without behavior change in one commit, then improve in a second commit.
